title: Governed Heartbeat Pattern v0
purpose: Provide a reusable institutional lifecycle for bounded execution that preserves human authority, provenance, evidence return, replay resistance, epistemic separation, and a required semantic-significance gate before any later integration.
required_sequence: reject replay while durable consumption evidence remains observable
archive exact source payloads with hashes
separate verified facts from self-reported consequence claims
hold integration pending an explicit semantic-significance decision
integrate only under a separate authorization gate
invariants: A successful workflow is evidence of execution, not automatic institutional truth.
Runtime consequence claims must not be promoted as independently observed facts without independent evidence.
One-shot authority must not be silently renewed after consumption.
Replay attempts must fail closed while authoritative consumption evidence is available; durable replay resistance requires preservation of consumed state outside ephemeral workflow history.
Evidence preservation must retain exact source payloads or accurately state its durability limits.
TRACE verification does not itself decide semantic significance.
Semantic significance must be decided before graph, Continuum, Canon, institutional-memory integration, external communication, or any other consequence-bearing promotion.
Human attention is required for meaning, authority, and irreversible or constitutional transitions—not routine evidence handling.
proven_capabilities: replay rejection against observable GitHub workflow-run and job history
network-disabled execution boundary for the demonstrated heartbeat
required_but_not_yet_proven_by_hb04b_hb0: separate authorization for any graph, Continuum, Canon, institutional-memory, or external consequence
durable consumed-state ledger independent of GitHub workflow-run and job retention
known_limits: The originating frontier-containment payload was a synthetic/pre-resolved test signal and is not promoted by this pattern as fresh external truth.
GitHub workflow artifacts are time-limited preservation surfaces until institutional Archivist ingestion occurs.

HB-04B replay rejection depends on discoverable GitHub workflow-run and successful consume-job history; if that history is deleted or becomes unavailable, the current guard may no longer prove prior consumption. A durable institutional consumed-state ledger is therefore required before claiming replay resistance independent of GitHub retention.
End-to-end content provenance for the original runtime return is transport-bound rather than cryptographically embedded in the runtime payload.
The demonstrated heartbeat used a network-disabled runtime boundary; this inheritance does not generalize that fact into permission for networked execution.

This pattern does not itself authorize graph mutation, Continuum writes, Canon promotion, institutional-memory integration, external communication, authority expansion, or any other consequence-bearing action.
adoption_rule: A future workflow may claim conformance to Governed Heartbeat Pattern v0 only if it satisfies the full required_sequence and invariants, preserves or explicitly strengthens every known-limit boundary, retains exact-payload/hash evidence preservation, does not infer network or consequence authority from this pattern, and keeps graph/Continuum/Canon/institutional-memory integration and external communication disabled until a separately evidenced semantic-significance decision and a separate explicit authorization gate are both satisfied.
